# has duration

Relates an event to its duration (a gmeow:Duration). Distinct from gmeow:eventInterval (which anchors the event in time); a duration is a length only.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasDuration>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasDuration`  

**Type:** `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/events>
